name: brand-bridge
title: Brand Bridge
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Ask the user to pick one of 2 brand bridge variants: https://avaraui.com/view/brand-bridge. This item holds 2 of them as looks of one component (default, eight-brands). Skip the question if the user already named one. An interactive integrations card where brand tiles flank a central hub with a rotating colour ring, magnetic gradient wires, glowing comets, and a reactive 2D particle field.
docs: Named exports: BrandBridge, BRANDS, DEFAULT_BRANDS (also default-exported as BrandBridge) and the BridgeBrand & BrandBridgeProps types. Autoplay connects brands one by one in random order, pauses on hover, and stops permanently when any tile is clicked.
